## Overview
The `taxaudit` package automates taxonomic diagnosability assessment using discrete morphological ontologies and pairwise character-state comparisons tailored for floristic works like the *Flora of Pakistan*.

## Quick Start Example
```{r setup}
library(taxaudit)
t1 <- "Plants annual. Leaves ovate, arrangement basal, margins entire, indumentum glabrous, flowers yellow, fruit achene."
t2 <- "Plants perennial. Leaves lanceolate, arrangement alternate, margins serrate, indumentum pubescent, flowers white, fruit capsule."
chars1 <- ta_extract_characters(t1)
chars2 <- ta_extract_characters(t2)
ta_pairwise_di(chars1, chars2)
```
